Finland's strategic reserves model sets an example for Europe in crisis preparedness
subhead: Distributed across the country, Finland's reserves – along its 1,340 kilometers of border with Russia – cover nine months of grain consumption and five months of its oil and gas needs. The system has emerged as a potential model for the European Union.

title: Israeli army says struck Hamas commander in Gaza hospital compound
subhead: The military said the commander 'was hiding within the compound' of Al-Aqsa Martyrs Hospital in the central city of Deir al-Balah, but was unable to immediately confirm if he had been killed. title: France's cheese producers worry after summer of heatwaves: 'If this happens again next year, it will be a disaster'
subhead: Heatwaves have taken a heavy toll on milk production, while scorched pastures have forced farmers to draw on feed reserves normally kept for winter. Producers of many protected-origin cheeses can no longer comply with the rules set out in their official specifications and are concerned about the future.

title: Russian propagandist Xenia Fedorova's highly political 'escape'
